method: Local BAAI/bge-m3 nearest-neighbor diagnostic on the candidate against 300 unique historical queries and 17 other retained current draft questions; review nearest question text manually. Similarity alone does not establish independence.

boundary: Bounded local text and vector screens do not prove no development exposure or final semantic independence. Recheck the complete final source family, question and answer set before Gold freeze.
